description: Convert your Mackenzie crib into a toddler bed with this easy-to-install conversion kit. Designed for both slat-back and panel-back Mackenzie cribs, this toddler bed kit provides a safe and comfortable next step. Crafted from solid hardwood with a warm BrownMaple finish that blends seamlessly with your Mackenzie nursery furniture.
